Overview

General information

The contest is currently running.

The contest started at Jan 1, 2025, 12:00:00 AM and will end at Jan 1, 2030, 12:00:00 AM.

You have two types of tokens: a set of contest-tokens shared among all tasks and a distinct set of task-tokens for each task. You start with 2 contest-tokens. Every 0.5 minutes you get another contest-token, up to a maximum of 5 contest-tokens. You can use no more than 10 contest-tokens in total. You can find the rules for the task-tokens on each task's description page.

You can see the detailed result of a submission by using two tokens on it, one of each type. Your score for each task will be the maximum among the tokened submissions and the last one.
